verdict.rationale: Recurring automation is shown only through third-party low-code platforms: a Zapier example runs a monthly export of card transactions to Google Drive, and Pipedream integrations cover monthly user limits and WFH-stipend cards whose limits reset every month. Brex's own API offers event-driven webhooks, but the evidence shows no native scheduler. Missing for 10: a native Brex job/workflow scheduler, documented recurring-workflow configuration in Brex itself, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
